notes.title: Updated to ver1.41
notes.content:
→ver1.41
Fixed a bug that some images were not displayed after updating to ver1.40.

notes.title: Version 1.40 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.40 Update
・While working to port the game for the Nintendo Switch, several scenes have been improve and are now included in this update. We feel that the quality of the graphics has been upgraded♪ 

・Several technical issues have been fixed.
-- While tests are made on this build, we would appreciate it if you could contact us if you find anything unusual.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.30
notes.content:
→ver 1.30
When the feet leave the ground, there is a small amount of time to accept a jump.
During this time, air bounces were given priority, but this has been corrected so that jumps will now occur.

Fixed a phenomenon in which some enemies would not be drawn for a moment.

Other internal changes have been made.

notes.title: Update Information (210721)
notes.content:
